metadata.name: Sample HSN/SAC GST rate reference
metadata.source: Compiled for this project from the publicly available CBIC GST goods and services rate schedules as understood by the dataset author, including the rate rationalisation effective 22 September 2025. Entries were NOT verified line-by-line against the official notification text.
metadata.legal_status: NOT LEGALLY AUTHORITATIVE. Demonstration dataset only. Verify every rate against the current CBIC notifications (https://cbic-gst.gov.in) before relying on it.

confidence_levels.high: Long-standing standard rate with no known conditions; mismatches are reported as errors.
confidence_levels.low: Rate changed recently, depends on conditions (packaging, value threshold, ITC option, exemption) or could not be confirmed; any check against it is sent to manual review.

metadata.matching: Invoice codes are matched to the longest code prefix in this file (e.g. 84713010 matches 8471).
